sampleSelection.criterion: 报告日业务统计中同时有期权和互换类别；SQL端结果上限5，实际只有1个候选。未要求两类当日余额都为正。
sampleSelection.customerBinding: 查询SQL中的${company_id}为匿名化绑定；本机复核所需原标识仅保留于.evidence-cache/customer-case-binding-20260923.json。

resultEncoding: JDBC CLI 将所有单元格字符串化，SQL NULL 输出为空字符串；本案例用独立 IS NULL / COALESCE 查询确认关键NULL，不能把所有文本空串自动当NULL。

freshness.query: SELECT 'amount_change' AS result_table,COUNT(*) AS rows_n,MIN(busi_date) AS first_day,MAX(busi_date) AS last_day FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_amount_change UNION ALL SELECT 'busi_stat' AS result_table,COUNT(*) AS rows_n,MIN(busi_date) AS first_day,MAX(busi_date) AS last_day FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_busi_stat UNION ALL SELECT 'cross_sale' AS result_table,COUNT(*) AS rows_n,MIN(busi_date) AS first_day,MAX(busi_date) AS last_day FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_cross_sale UNION ALL SELECT 'cust_index' AS result_table,COUNT(*) AS rows_n,MIN(busi_date) AS first_day,MAX(busi_date) AS last_day FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_cust_index UNION ALL SELECT 'cust_tag' AS result_table,COUNT(*) AS rows_n,MIN(busi_date) AS first_day,MAX(busi_date) AS last_day FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_cust_tag UNION ALL SELECT 'hold_pnl' AS result_table,COUNT(*) AS rows_n,MIN(busi_date) AS first_day,MAX(busi_date) AS last_day FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_hold_pnl UNION ALL SELECT 'swap_trd_stat' AS result_table,COUNT(*) AS rows_n,MIN(busi_date) AS first_day,MAX(busi_date) AS last_day FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_swap_trd_stat UNION ALL SELECT 'underlying_analysis' AS result_table,COUNT(*) AS rows_n,MIN(busi_date) AS first_day,MAX(busi_date) AS last_day FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_underlying_analysis UNION ALL SELECT 'year_revenue',COUNT(*),CAST(MIN(year) AS CHAR),CAST(MAX(year) AS CHAR) FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_year_revenue LIMIT 9

business.query: SELECT busi_type_1,busi_type_2,last_year_new_amount,this_year_new_amount,stock_size,cross_border_opt_amount,npv_revenue,real_pnl,profit_rate,CAST(data_datetime AS CHAR) AS synced_at FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_busi_stat WHERE company_id='${company_id}' AND busi_date='2026-03-25' ORDER BY busi_type_1,busi_type_2 LIMIT 20

rows.busi_type_2: 南下跨境-其他股票市场
其他期权（除Risky和安全气囊X）

daily.query: SELECT CAST(busi_date AS CHAR) AS busi_date,option_amount_change,swap_amount_change,CAST(data_datetime AS CHAR) AS synced_at FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_amount_change WHERE company_id='${company_id}' AND busi_date BETWEEN '2026-03-23' AND '2026-03-25' ORDER BY busi_date LIMIT 10

index.query: SELECT CAST(busi_date AS CHAR) AS busi_date,cust_hold_win_rate,cust_win_rate,margin_ratio,margin_call_line,outst_margin_amount,used_quota,approved_quota,margin_call_rate,swap_turnover_rate,swap_new_principal,swap_outst_month_end,swap_platform_fee,swap_bond_interest,swap_commission,CAST(data_datetime AS CHAR) AS synced_at FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_cust_index WHERE company_id='${company_id}' AND busi_date='2026-03-25' LIMIT 5

year.query: SELECT year,option_revenue,swap_revenue,cross_sale_amount,cross_border_revenue,CAST(data_datetime AS CHAR) AS synced_at FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_year_revenue WHERE company_id='${company_id}' AND year IN (2025,2026) ORDER BY year LIMIT 4

hold.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_n,SUM(hold_amount) AS hold_wan,SUM(current_pnl) AS pnl_wan,SUM(ABS(current_pnl)) AS abs_pnl_wan,SUM(pnl_ratio) AS ratio_sum,SUM(ABS(pnl_ratio)) AS abs_ratio_sum,SUM(current_pnl IS NULL) AS null_pnl_rows,MIN(CAST(data_datetime AS CHAR)) AS first_sync,MAX(CAST(data_datetime AS CHAR)) AS last_sync FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_hold_pnl WHERE company_id='${company_id}' AND busi_date='2026-03-25' LIMIT 1

trade.query: SELECT COALESCE(CAST(busi_date AS CHAR),'__SQL_NULL__') AS busi_date,time_period,weekly_trd_freq,avg_trd_amount,trd_win_rate,yield_rate,swap_first_trd_type,swap_second_trd_type,swap_first_trd_count,swap_second_trd_count,CAST(data_datetime AS CHAR) AS synced_at FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_swap_trd_stat WHERE company_id='${company_id}' ORDER BY time_period LIMIT 5

tags.query: SELECT tag_name,COALESCE(CAST(busi_date AS CHAR),'__SQL_NULL__') AS busi_date,CAST(data_datetime AS CHAR) AS synced_at FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_cust_tag WHERE company_id='${company_id}' ORDER BY tag_name LIMIT 20

nulls.query: SELECT margin_call_rate IS NULL AS call_rate_is_null,swap_platform_fee IS NULL AS platform_fee_is_null,swap_bond_interest IS NULL AS bond_interest_is_null,swap_commission IS NULL AS commission_is_null FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_cust_index WHERE company_id='${company_id}' AND busi_date='2026-03-25' LIMIT 2

comparison_days.query: SELECT CAST(busi_date AS CHAR) AS busi_date,SUM(CASE WHEN busi_type_1='互换' THEN stock_size ELSE 0 END) AS swap_stock_yuan,SUM(CASE WHEN busi_type_1='期权' THEN real_pnl ELSE 0 END) AS option_ytd_income_yuan,SUM(CASE WHEN busi_type_1='互换' THEN real_pnl ELSE 0 END) AS swap_ytd_income_yuan,COUNT(DISTINCT company_name) AS names_n FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_busi_stat WHERE company_id='${company_id}' AND busi_date BETWEEN '2026-03-22' AND '2026-03-25' GROUP BY busi_date ORDER BY busi_date LIMIT 4

hold_columns.query: SELECT column_name,column_type,column_comment FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='gf_otc' AND table_name='bi_otc_hold_pnl' ORDER BY ordinal_position LIMIT 15

dates_null.query: SELECT 'cust_tag' AS source_name,COUNT(*) AS rows_n,SUM(busi_date IS NULL) AS null_dates FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_cust_tag UNION ALL SELECT 'swap_trd_stat',COUNT(*),SUM(busi_date IS NULL) FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_swap_trd_stat LIMIT 2

identity.query: SELECT 'busi_stat' AS source_name,COUNT(DISTINCT company_name) AS names_n FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_busi_stat WHERE company_id='${company_id}' AND busi_date='2026-03-25' UNION ALL SELECT 'cust_index',COUNT(DISTINCT company_name) FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_cust_index WHERE company_id='${company_id}' AND busi_date='2026-03-25' UNION ALL SELECT 'hold_pnl',COUNT(DISTINCT company_name) FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_hold_pnl WHERE company_id='${company_id}' AND busi_date='2026-03-25' UNION ALL SELECT 'year_revenue',COUNT(DISTINCT company_name) FROM gf_otc.bi_otc_year_revenue WHERE company_id='${company_id}' LIMIT 4

upstreamAttempt.submittedQuery: SELECT busi_date,grp_id,Busi_Type,COUNT(*) AS row_count,MIN(Accrued_Date) AS first_accrued,MAX(Accrued_Date) AS last_accrued,SUM(CASE WHEN Accrued_Date=busi_date THEN Dyna_Nom_Prin ELSE 0 END) AS current_principal FROM dm_otc_n.otc_rev_daily_rpt WHERE busi_date IN ('2026-03-25','2026-09-22') AND USCC='${company_id}' GROUP BY busi_date,grp_id,Busi_Type LIMIT 12

transportEvidence.querySql:
select
  company_name,
  company_id,
  busi_date,
  underlying_name,
  hold_amount,
  current_pnl,
  pnl_ratio
from dm_otc_n.bi_otc_hold_pnl
where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
and underlying_name not like '%;%'

select
 company_name,
 company_id,
 busi_year,
 option_revenue,
 swap_revenue,
 cross_sale_amount,
 cross_border_revenue
from dm_otc_n.bi_otc_year_revenue
where busi_year in( '${yyyy, -1y}', '${yyyy}')

select
company_name
,company_id
,busi_date
,option_amount_change
,swap_amount_change
from dm_otc_n.bi_otc_amount_change
where busi_date between '${yyyy-MM-dd, -12M}' and '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
